testCase.name: [本地] S22 Both lists through axe; cards and trash controls have accessible names

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 A3 · P2 · 无障碍

按钮套按钮：卡片里的垃圾桶、In Today 开关嵌在卡片按钮里面，读屏选不到

票：TFA-92579 · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地（视觉巡检）

思路 / Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S22 「两个列表都过 axe；卡片和垃圾桶控件有无障碍名字」 Both lists through axe; cards and trash controls have accessible names

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 Tapping a card opens that exact patient's Pre-Round view.（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 5）
  • T5 A patient card can be removed by tapping its trash icon; a pop-up designed like the app UI tells the user what happens if they delete, and the user presses Cancel or OK.（TFA-92579 AC 7）

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Standard fixture, visual lane screens hospital-list and nh-list

When Visual lane runs axe-core on both lists

Then Findings are reviewed by a person; each card is a button named 'Open chart for <name>'; each trash control has a name

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Lane V decides nothing: axe findings on hospital-list and nh-list go to a human (visual-checks.ts maps serious/critical to severity 'medium'), and serious/critical ones are routed to TFA-92579. Expected from the code: nested-interactive (serious) on the Hospital card, whose trash <button> sits inside the role="button" card div (PatientCard.tsx); …

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（automated）

S22 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；Allure 状态按分诊从 passed 改成 failed。

问题分类：无障碍 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92579 ready for qa

医院列表里，垃圾桶按钮嵌在卡片自己的按钮里面，读屏用户没法单独选到「Remove <病人>」；养老院 All Residents 的 In Today 开关也是一样的问题。

On the Hospital list the trash button sits inside the card's own button, so a screen-reader user cannot reach 'Remove <patient>' on its own; Nursing Home All Residents has the same problem with the In Today toggle.

依据：visual lane, axe nested-interactive (serious) on desktop, iphone15 and pixel7. Record-only per the oracle ('Lane V decides nothing') and routed to TFA-92579 AC 7. 24 of 27 then-clause checks held: every card is 'Open chart for <name>' and every control inside has a name.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。

UAT item: TC-01 Patient Chart Card · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-01/S22

Both lists through axe; cards and trash controls have accessible names

Tickets: TFA-92579 Home Screen: Patient Chart Card (ready for qa)

本地新 lane visual：visual/results.json 里 status record-only → 通过（只记录（判过的都通过；带一个待定的产品问题，写在说明里））。

怎么测（visual/plan.json，automatable: yes）：lists.spec.ts: two seeded patients per context; card names 'Open chart for <name>', names of controls inside cards (trash), axe nested-interactive judged per the oracle (routed as a real AC 7 issue), other axe recorded. [2026-10-14 review] Record-only: the oracle says 'Lane V decides nothing'; the same checks run but are written as unjudged then-clause values (Verdict.recordOnly), and the nested-interactive finding is routed to TFA-92579 as the oracle asks.

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: record-only (oracle: Lane V decides nothing; axe findings go to a human, serious/critical routed to TFA-92579). Then-clause checks evaluated, not judged: 24 held, 3 did not. Record-only per the oracle ('Lane V decides nothing … routed to TFA-92579'). Then-clause checks (held, not judged): every card is a button named 'Open chart for <name>' and every control inside a card has a name, in both lists.

产品问题：Routed to TFA-92579 (record-only, as the oracle asks): on the Hospital list the trash (Remove …) button sits inside the card's role=button — axe nested-interactive (serious). A screen-reader user cannot reliably reach 'Remove <patient> from the rounding list' on its own; it is read as part of the card (TFA-92579 AC 7, as the oracle predicts). NH All Residents has the same pattern with the In Today toggle.

证据：附了 6 个；没附 1 个：

  • visual/evidence/TC-01_S22 — 目录（21 项），不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
